_unconfirmed.golkar2023xval: arXiv comment claims 'NeurIPS Workshop on ML for the Physical Sciences'. Not found in the paper lists on https://ml4physicalsciences.github.io/2023/ (207 entries) or /2024/ (no 'xVal'/'Golkar'). OpenReview shows: NeurIPS 2023 AI4Science workshop poster under the earlier title 'xVal: A Continuous Number Encoding for Large Language Models' (forum KHDMZtoF4i); ICLR 2024 rejected (OinvjdvPjp); TMLR rejected (kSPHESKMve). No archival peer-reviewed venue confirmed; cite as arXiv (or, if wanted, the AI4Science workshop poster).
_unconfirmed.chen2024posthinking: arXiv comment: accepted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems. IEEE Xplore (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11127195, reached via doi.org/10.1109/tnnls.2025.3591266) is bot-walled (HTTP 202 empty body; REST API 401; WebFetch empty), so not confirmed on an official IEEE page. The IEEE-deposited Crossref record (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1109/tnnls.2025.3591266) says: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, vol 36, no 11, pp 19820-19833, Nov 2025, title 'Distilling Reasoning Ability From Large Language Models With Adaptive Thinking'. Promote it if you accept Crossref, as you did for the two Crossref-sourced keys.
